'''''Phoenix Nest''''', also known as '''''Phoenix Home''''' and originally known as the '''''Liberator''''', was an [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|Imperial light carrier]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]] as a mobile base of operations to periodically launch bombers on the planet [[Ryloth]]. Three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]] the [[Spectres]], alongside [[Cham Syndulla]] of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]], [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|stole]] the ship for the rebellion.

The carrier, now a part of the growing rebel fleet, was used to house the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wings]] of [[Phoenix Cell]], and was repainted by the rebel [[Sabine Wren]] to show its new affiliation. The [[cruiser]]-[[carrier]] and the rest of the Phoenix rebel fleet were later [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attacked]] by Imperial forces under [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]]. The cruiser-carrier later hosted the Spectres' starship, the ''[[Ghost]]'', which had returned with [[Heist at Horizon Base|stolen]] [[fuel]] supplies from [[Horizon Base]]. After [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] and [[Phoenix Leader]] [[Hera Syndulla]] received information from the [[inventory droid]] [[AP-5]] that the Imperials had set a trap in the [[Yost system]], the starship fled with the rest of the rebel fleet to the planet [[Atollon]].

[[2 BBY|Six months later]], Commander Sato mobilized the fleet to assist [[Ezra Bridger]]'s team in a [[Mission to Reklam Station|scouting mission]] at [[Reklam Station]]. The team managed to land their newly-captured [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s aboard the carrier. Once everyone was accounted for, the fleet returned to Chopper Base. The carrier was later destroyed during the [[Battle of Atollon]], where Commander Sato crashed it into an [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]] in order to provide an opening for Ezra Bridger to escape the system.

==History==
===Imperial service===
[[File:Ryloth-task-force.png|thumb|300px||left|Before being christened ''Phoenix Nest'', the light carrier was in Imperial service over Ryloth.]]
In the [[3 BBY|third]] [[Standard year|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Theft date">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' places the events of "[[Homecoming]]" 16 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which occurred in [[19 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', meaning that "Homecoming" takes place in [[3 BBY]].</ref> this [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|light carrier]] was stationed at [[Ryloth]]. There it was used by the [[Galactic Empire]] to house the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bombers]] that bombarded Ryloth's surface.<ref name="Homecoming" />

===Hijacking of the carrier===
[[Phoenix Cell]] leader, [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]], learned of the carrier and suggested that [[Phoenix Leader]], [[Captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]], and the [[Spectres]] should steal the [[Starship|ship]] with help from the [[Free Ryloth Movement]]. Syndulla then contacted the movement's leader and her [[Parent|father]], [[General]] [[Cham Syndulla]] to arrange the theft. Together, the Spectres and Syndulla's team planned to infiltrate the light [[carrier]]. However, Cham wanted to blow the light carrier as message to his [[Twi'lek]] people, but went along with his daughter's plan to steal the carrier instead.<ref name="Homecoming" />

Using a stolen [[TIE series|TIE bomber]], Syndulla's team and the Spectres were able to [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|board]] the carrier when the [[bomber]]s left on their bombing run. They then pretended to be under attack by a pair [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wings]] and request an emergency landing. After their crash landing, [[Sabine Wren]] discovered that Syndulla and his team were planning on destroying it with [[detonator]]s instead. Syndulla then tied up his daughter while [[Gobi Glie]] and [[Numa]] [[stun]]ned the rest of the Spectres. However, the Spectres were able to come to and continue their mission to take the carrier.<ref name="Homecoming" />

While Wren and [[Garazeb Orrelios]] subdued Gobi and Numa, [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Ezra Bridger]], and Hera then went to the carrier's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. There, Bridger was able to use a [[mind trick]] to force the carrier's commander to order his crew to abandon ship. Hera then attempted to jump into [[hyperspace]], but her father had disabled the [[hyperdrive]]. However, Syndulla was then convinced by his daughter to allow the rebellion to use it against the Empire instead of destroying it. Together, the Spectres and Syndulla's team then manned the carrier's [[turbolaser]] batteries against a shuttle of Imperial troops that attempted to board it to retake the ship from the rebels and then against the returning TIE bombers.<ref name="Homecoming" />

[[File:Phoenixhomehangar.png|thumb|220x220px|The hangar in Phoenix Nest after it was captured by the rebellion.]]
The carrier was lightly damaged by the bombers, causing it to lose its [[stabilizer]]s and nearly fall into Ryloth's atmosphere before both Syndullas managed to right the ship. However, the carrier was then confronted by an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]]. While Chopper repaired the hyperdrive, Syndulla, Bridger, and Wren came up with a plan to stop the light cruiser from preventing their escape, loading an unmanned TIE bomber with explosives to cast into the pursuing vessel's path. Once it was close enough to the [[light cruiser]], Syndulla destroyed it with a turbolaser blast and the exploding bomber ignited the light cruiser's forward magazine compartment. After the light [[cruiser]] went down into Ryloth's atmosphere in flames, the carrier then jumped to hyperspace and rendezvoused with [[Phoenix Squadron]].<ref name="Homecoming" />

===Search for a new base===
The carrier then became the new [[flagship]] of Phoenix [[Squadron]], designated as ''Phoenix Nest'' and was given a decorative paintjob of [[Color|orange]] and yellow markings on its hull to denote its new affiliation. However, ''Phoenix Nest'' did not have enough [[fuel]] to reach [[Berzite]]'s [[Berzite's moon|moon]] in the [[Yost system]]. The Spectres then [[Heist at Horizon Base|acquired]] the needed fuel from the Imperial Depot at [[Horizon Base]]. ''Phoenix Nest'' along with the rest of the fleet then came under [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack]] by the [[Imperial Navy]] under [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]]. Despite difficulty, the ''[[Ghost]]'' was able to refuel the ''Phoenix Nest''. At the last [[Standard minute|minute]], [[C1-10P|Chopper]] and [[AP-5]] then told them about the ambush in the Yost [[Star system|system]] and suggested that [[Atollon]] would be a safer location. With the carrier fully fueled, the fleet jumped to their new destination.<ref name="The Forgotten Droid" />

''Phoenix Nest'' then provided the ''Ghost'' with [[power generator]]s for the new [[Chopper Base|base]].<ref name="Mystery of Chopper Base">{{Rebels|The Mystery of Chopper Base}}</ref>

===New bombers===
[[2 BBY|Six months later]],<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=episodes/steps-into-shadow-trivia-gallery|text="Steps Into Shadow" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> during the [[mission to Reklam Station]], the carrier arrived over [[Yarma]] to help [[transport]] stolen [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s. After the Y-wings landed, the carrier jumped to hyperspace.<ref name="Steps">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]''</ref> Following the success of [[Operation Handoff]], the carrier went to [[Dantooine]] to show Phoenix Squadron's support for Senator [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|Declaration]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref>

===Destruction===
During the [[Battle of Atollon]] in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Destruction date" /> the carrier served as a command ship alongside General [[Jan Dodonna]]'s Nebulon-B frigate ''[[Vanguard]]''. As the battle raged on with many rebel losses. Commander Jun Sato elected to sacrifice himself and the carrier in order to provide an opening. Sato ordered the evacuation of ''Phoenix Nest'', aside from two pilots who volunteered to stay with their commander, before [[ramming]] the ship into [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor]], destroying both vessels. In doing so, Sato allowed [[Lieutenant Commander]] Ezra Bridger to jump to hyperspace and call for reinforcements from [[Clan Wren]], who came to support and helped some rebel forces escape.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

==Behind the scenes==
The carrier appears in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' animated television series, first appearing in the episode "[[Homecoming]]."<ref name="Homecoming" />
